How We Work

From Vision to
Reality

Our five-phase process ensures clarity, transparency, and creative excellence at every stage — from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

1

Phase One

Consultation

Every project begins with a conversation. We learn about your lifestyle, preferences, budget, and aspirations. This isn't a sales pitch — it's a genuine dialogue where we listen more than we talk. By the end, we'll know whether we're the right studio for your project.

Duration: 30–60 minutes (complimentary)

Deliverable: Project feasibility assessment & preliminary scope

2

Phase Two

Spatial Audit

Our team visits your space to conduct a thorough audit — measuring, photographing, and analyzing every dimension. We map existing conditions, natural light patterns, structural elements, and circulation flows. This data becomes the foundation for every design decision that follows.

Duration: 1–3 days depending on project scale

Deliverable: Comprehensive site report with measurements & analysis

3

Phase Three

Design Concept

This is where creativity meets data. We develop mood boards, floor plans, material palettes, and 3D visualizations that bring your space to life before a single wall is touched. You'll see multiple concept options and collaborate with us to refine the direction.

Duration: 2–4 weeks

Deliverable: Concept presentation with plans, 3D renders & material specifications

4

Phase Four

Execution

With the approved design in hand, we coordinate with our trusted network of contractors, craftspeople, and vendors to bring the concept to reality. Our project manager oversees every detail — from demolition schedules to furniture delivery timelines — ensuring quality and adherence to plan.

Duration: 4–16 weeks depending on scope

Deliverable: Weekly progress reports & quality checkpoints

5

Phase Five

Handover

The final reveal. We walk through every room together, ensuring every detail meets our shared vision. You'll receive a complete project dossier — maintenance guides, vendor contacts, warranty information, and care instructions for every material and finish in your new space.

Duration: 1 day + 30-day post-completion support

Deliverable: Project dossier, keys, and a beautifully transformed space
